record_type_quote: Lastly, in Experiment 3, we attempted to replicate the work of Palm (2008) who was able to triple the number of realistic responses by creating problems with a richer backstory and providing more detail. Our sample of sixth-grade students failed to show an increase in realistic responses to these, enhanced, versions of realistic word problems.
